material_unsupported_claims: 测试频率为每 3–6 个月（放射技师）或每年（医学物理师及束几何验证）
所有来源一致指出上述数值
review.visual_understanding: Gold image (p.184) shows Table 8 for radiographers: Section 2.1.1 lists alignment ±2% of SID, centring ±1% of SID, frequency 3–6 months, reference [4,5]. Another image (p.189) shows Section 3.2.2 (beam geometry) with same tolerances, frequency annual, reference [4,5]. No source states medical physicists test this quarterly; citation 2 (p.195) lists Section 2.2.1 for medical physicists with frequency '3–6 months', not annual.
review.reason: Answer incorrectly states medical physicists and beam geometry verification are done annually; per citation 2 (p.195), Section 2.2.1 (medical physicists) frequency is 3–6 months, matching radiographers. Only Section 3.2.2 (beam geometry, citation 4) is annual. The claim 'all sources一致' is unsupported—citations 1/3 (radiographers) and 2 (physicists) both say 3–6 months, while 4 says annual for a different test section. Tolerances themselves (±2%/±1% SID) are correctly cited from required sources 2 and 4.
